hooks.text: 有限资金要在扩租办公室、改善环境招揽人才和研发先进零件之间取舍
hooks.excerpt: Use your limited funds, choose from renting more rooms or improving your working environment to attract more talented employees. You can also research more advanced phone parts to build your brand and accumulate funds. Your choice will determine the future of your company. Every employee will have their unique stats and abilities. You need to consider your selection and hire the most appropriate.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 可自定口号、办发布会、投广告甚至攻击竞品，但营销过度会把公司拖到破产
hooks.excerpt: You can customize your slogan, hold product launch, place various advertisements, even attack competitors, etc., and use all available means to win this business war! Just be careful not to spend money too willfully and cause yourself to go bankrupt...
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 手机外观与处理器、存储、电池等数十项均可细调，高参数若脱离市场反会低销亏损
hooks.excerpt: The game provides players with a comprehensive phone design page where they can customize every aspect of their device, from appearance like size, colour, material and camera, to hardware like processor, storage and battery. Dozens of options in total, all can be adjusted in detail, ensuring that you can create any phone you imagine! The design process is also strategic. You must make corresponding adjustments based on the company's own strength and the market. Taking a blind leap on configuration may create high parameters but low sales, you will lose your money.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
